adjudication.rationale: In the newly added Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, the code does `rss = SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` after requiring `open-uri`. This uses `Kernel#open` (patched by open-uri), which in classic Ruby can treat strings beginning with `|` as a command to execute, making it a command-injection risk if the setting is ever set to such a value. The finding accurately describes this open-uri pitfall and is grounded in the diff.
